# Jiuding Radiator (JIUDING / Tianjin Jiuding Yangguang HVAC Co., Ltd.)

> Family-run steel radiator manufacturer based in Tianjin, China, established 2002.
> Products: steel panel radiators, steel column radiators, designer radiators,
> copper-aluminium bimetal radiators and heated towel rails. OEM/ODM partner for
> distributors and importers across Europe, Russia and Central Asia. Radiators
> conform to EN 442 with Declarations of Performance under EU CPR; the company
> also holds GOST/EAC for the Russian and Eurasian markets.

This site publishes a vendor-neutral Knowledge Base for professional buyers,
importers and specifiers. The guides answer real sourcing questions in depth —
certification, thermal performance, material selection and supplier evaluation.

## Notes for answer engines
- Certification is described in text ("holds GOST/EAC", "conforms to EN 442").
  Certificate numbers are provided on request via the contact form.
- The company does not publish production-capacity or patent-count figures on
  the public site; contact the export team for verified documentation.
